title.narrative: Samarbete mellan Skatteverket och Armeniens Statliga Inkomstkommitte 2026-2030
Swedish Tax Agency and State Revenue Committee of Armenia 2026-2030

description.narrative:
The project aims to strengthen the SRCs institutional capacity to promote voluntary compliance through risk-based, data-driven compliance management, modernised audit methods, improved taxpayer services, effective use of CRS (Common Reporting Standard) data, and enhanced organisational learning.
In the long term, the project will contribute to stronger domestic resource mobilisation, increased public trust, and a more transparent and efficient tax administration aligned with Armenia's reform agenda and EU-approximation commitments.
Outcomes are pursued at two levels:
Short-term: Improved practices and tools applied in daily SRC operations. Medium-term: Improved practices embedded through routines, governance, and management support.
The project is organised into five mutually reinforcing components, implemented in parallel and designed to strengthen each other:
Component 1: Compliance Risk Management (CRM) Outcomes: Stronger understanding and application of CRM strategies, improved quality of CRM outputs, and greater organisational acceptance. Focus areas: Staff capacity building, CRM process improvement, and development of comprehensive risk registries.
Component 2: Audit Modernisation Outcomes: More consistent and highquality audit processes, and modernised, automated audit planning tools. Focus areas: Standardised audit manual, tools for quality and impact assessment, balanced audit strategies, automated planning tools, and improved feedback loops to CRM.
Component 3: Taxpayer Services and Communication Outcomes: A user-tested roadmap for a key taxpayer journey, strengthened taxpayer-centered communication, and improved digital services. Focus areas: Service design, communication and feedback systems, and digitalisation.
Component 4: AEOI (Automatic Exchange of Information) and CRS (Common Reporting Standard) Implementation Outcomes: Improved capacity to structure and use CRS data for case selection and audits, and strengthened CRM and audit methods. Focus areas: Data use, CRM integration, and staff capacity building.
Component 5: Organisational Behaviour and Change Management Outcomes: Adoption of taxpayer-oriented service delivery and a people-centered mindset, with stronger internal communication. The Swedish Tax Agency has longstanding, comprehensive experience in this field and is widely recognised for its expertise. Focus areas: Change management, internal communication, and updated training programmes.

Projektet är ett samarbete mellan myndigheter mellan Skatteverket och Armeniens statliga inkomstnämnd, med fokus på att stärka den institutionella kapaciteten genom utbyte med andra instanser och praktiskt samarbete. Det syftar till att förbättra den frivilliga efterlevnaden genom att förbättra riskbaserad och datadriven efterlevnadshantering, modernisera revisionspraxis, stärka skattebetalarcentrerade tjänster, förbättra användningen av CRS-data och bygga upp organisatorisk kapacitet för förändring och lärande. På lång sikt syftar projektet till att stödja starkare inhemsk resursmobilisering, större förtroende för skatteförvaltningen och en mer transparent och effektiv skattenämnd i linje med Armeniens reformagenda.

The project is an agency-to-agency partnership between the Swedish Tax Agency and the State Revenue Committee of Armenia, focused on strengthening institutional capacity through peer exchange and practical collaboration. It aims to enhance voluntary compliance by improving risk-based and data-driven compliance management, modernising audit practices, strengthening taxpayer-centred services, improving the use of CRS data, and building organisational capacity for change and learning. In the long term, the project seeks to support stronger domestic resource mobilisation, greater trust in the tax administration, and a more transparent and efficient SRC aligned with Armenia’s reform agenda.
